clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, the Filled Jade Phial is carried back with sacred water from Starbreeze Village. The water helps replenish the central wells while young night elves learn their people's history.

Druids in Darnassus draw sacred moonwell water from across Teldrassil to replenish their central wells. Corithras Moonrage entrusts young travelers in Dolanaar with a jade phial made to hold the pure water safely. The moonwell outside Starbreeze Village lies east of Dolanaar. Initiates collect its water as they tend the World Tree.

When you bring the Filled Jade Phial back to Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage shares another chapter of kaldorei history. He tells of the years after the Third War, when Nordrassil burned, night elves lost their immortality, the Betrayer was released, and Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage disappeared.
